verdict.rationale: Zep is API-first: it ships a Python SDK, a full OpenAPI 3.1 REST API, and the zepctl CLI, which gives "full access to Zep" from the terminal, so scripted, headless use is directly supported. Graph cloning also supports isolated test data. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI pipelines, non-interactive or token-based auth for automation, or zepctl scripting and exit-code behavior. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD usage docs, non-interactive auth guidance for zepctl, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: It provides full access to Zep, enabling you to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal.
help.getzep.com serves a full OpenAPI 3.1 document (info title "SDK Reference", 148 paths, servers https://api.getzep.com/api/v4).
Clone a shared Context Graph to create an isolated test copy of an account, project, product, or business-domain graph
